title: Binance Accelerator Program - Quantitative Trading Strategy Algorithm
description: Binance Accelerator Program - Quantitative Trading Strategy Algorithm Hong Kong / Taiwan, Taipei / Australia, Sydney Engineering – Data Science/AI / Binance Accelerator Program / Remote apply for this job Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means. About Binance Accelerator Program Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it s like to work at the world s leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE. Who may apply Current university students and recent graduates. *Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws About the Role We are building an AI-driven trading system covering traditional financial assets such as equities as well as on-chain assets. We are looking for a Quantitative Trading Strategy Algorithm Intern who is passionate about trading strategies to participate in research spanning factor discovery, factor prediction, and trading strategy and system construction — combining quantitative research capabilities with AI technology to grow rapidly through real-world strategy R&D. Responsibilities Participate in the discovery, construction, and validation of trading factors, exploring effective alpha signals from multi-source data including market data, fundamental data, and on-chain data. Participate in the design and optimization of factor prediction models, applying machine learning and deep learning methods to enhance signal predictive power and stability. Participate in the design, backtesting, and validation of trading strategies, assisting with signal generation, portfolio construction, and risk control research. Participate in building the quantitative trading strategy pipeline, helping to streamline the R&D workflow from data, factors, and models to backtesting. Track frontier methods in quantitative and AI-driven trading, conducting exploratory research that combines the market characteristics of traditional equities and on-chain assets. Requirements Current Master s or PhD student in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, Physics, or a related field, with a strong quantitative foundation and programming skills, able to commit to stable weekly internship hours. Strong interest in quantitative trading strategies, familiarity with factor mining and strategy backtesting workflows, and a basic understanding of strategy return and risk. Proficient in Python, knowledgeable about ML/DL methods applied in quantitative scenarios, and experienced in handling financial time-series data. Understanding of trading mechanisms and data characteristics in at least one market (equities, futures, or other traditional financial markets; or crypto and on-chain assets). Strong learning ability and research enthusiasm, high initiative, and ability to continuously explore in a fast-iterating environment. Nice to Have Course projects, competitions (e.g., quant competitions, Kaggle), or internship experience in quantitative research. Exposure to quantitative research across both traditional finance and on-chain markets (DeFi, CEX, DEX). Practical experience applying machine learning, reinforcement learning, or similar methods to financial data or trading scenarios. Publications, open-source projects, or personal research outcomes in finance or mathematical modeling. Why Binance • Shape the future with the world s leading blockchain ecosystem • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning • Competitive salary and company benefits • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. apply for this job

Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: AI Response Analyst
description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension
